description: This file contains utility functions for process management, including opening pipes, connecting pipes to process file descriptors, executing processes, and terminating processes. It appears to be part of process handling in a UNIX-like environment.

methods.name: void pipes_close(int pipe_in[],int pipe_out[],int pipe_err[])
methods.description: Closes the given pipe file descriptors if they are open.

methods.name: void pipes_close_unneeded(int pipe_in[],int pipe_out[],int pipe_err[])
methods.description: Closes unneeded pipe ends for process setup.

methods.name: int pipes_open(int * fd_in,int * fd_out,int * fd_err,int pipe_in[],int pipe_out[],int pipe_err[])
methods.description: Creates pipes for process input, output, and error streams.

methods.name: int pipes_connect(int pipe_in[],int pipe_out[],int pipe_err[])
methods.description: Connects pipes to standard input/output/error for the child process.

methods.name: int process_execute(char * path,char * const argv[],pid_t * pid,int * pfd_in,int * pfd_out,int * pfd_err)
methods.description: Forks and executes a process, setting up pipes for communication.

methods.name: int process_terminate(pid_t pid)
methods.description: Terminates a process given its PID.
